name: CAKELORD
title: Cakelord — Personal Portfolio
description: Cakelord’s personal portfolio. Visual design, interaction, and creative experiments.
about: A growing collection of my work, process, and explorations. The projects currently shown are layout demos; original work is coming soon.

projects.title: FORM / Form Study
projects.summary: Circles, space, and repetition. Exploring rhythm with a minimal set of elements.
projects.description: A layout demo for this portfolio, not a completed personal project. This space will introduce the brief, my role, the design process, and the final outcome.

projects.title: TYPE / Type Play
projects.summary: Words become shapes. A study in type, contrast, and unexpected directions.
projects.description: A typography layout demo. A future case study will explore type choices, composition, and applications across different media.

projects.title: MOVE / Motion Notes
projects.summary: Move your pointer and watch the shapes respond. An experiment in motion and rhythm.
projects.description: An interaction layout demo. The geometric shapes on the homepage respond to pointer movement and respect reduced-motion preferences.
